newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy mulls power marketing options.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy mulls power marketing options.

text.p: PanEnergy Corp is mulling options for controlling firm electric generating capacity to expand its nationwide power marketing operation, company executives said on Tuesday.

The Houston-based natural gas pipeline and power marketing company, drawing from a blueprint used to build its natural gas marketing franchise, is considering acquisitions, alliances and contracting generating capacity to build a foundation for a nationwide electric marketing operation, the executives said.

"We're working on a lot of potential acquisitions in the electricity sector," L.B. Gatewood, president of the company's trading and marketing services business unit, said at the Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc energy conference in Houston.

Gatewood declined comment on specific options being pursued by the company, which analysts expect to eventually merge with a domestic electric utility as part of the ongoing consolidation of the electric and natural gas industries.
Spokesman Brad Porlier said PanEnergy expects to control firm electric capacity through the combination of contracts, alliances and possible acquisitions of electric utilities in key markets.
"In our case, it's going to be a combination of all those things," he told Reuters. "As we build our electric business, we need a firm source of electric supply."
